Educational estimates only — not financial advice. Taxes, insurance, HOA and PMI are not included.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your gross annual income and current monthly debt payments.
  2. Add your down payment, expected rate and loan term.
  3. Read your maximum affordable home price and monthly payment.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the 28/36 rule?

The 28/36 rule: housing costs should be at most 28% of gross monthly income (front-end), and all debts including housing at most 36% (back-end). This calculator uses the lower of the two.

How is the affordable price calculated?

Your maximum monthly housing payment is the smaller of 28% of gross monthly income and (36% of gross monthly income minus your other monthly debts). That payment is converted to a loan amount, then the down payment is added.

Does this include property taxes and insurance?

This is a principal-and-interest estimate only. Real lenders add taxes, insurance, HOA and PMI, which reduce what you can afford.
